# Nick Harris

> Personal site of Nick Harris: founder of Skylight Studio, builder of Setlist.ID and Miniverse, one half of Blonde Brunette. Based in Barcelona.

Nick Harris is an entrepreneur and analytics leader based in Barcelona, Spain. Born in South Africa, raised in Florida. Founder of Skylight Studio, a consulting studio that brings organization and technology to small businesses. Before that, he spent a decade building analytics practices in motorsports, logistics, energy, and healthcare. He makes music as one half of Blonde Brunette. He builds Setlist.ID, a tool for identifying tracklists in DJ mixes, and Miniverse, social media for the people in your life. Founder and board member of ReMade BCN, a community-run makerspace in Barcelona focused on open tools, learning, and collaboration.

## Projects

- [Skylight Studio](https://skylightstudio.co): Consulting studio founded by Nick Harris. Brings organization and technology to small businesses.
- [Setlist.ID](https://setlist.id): Tool for identifying tracklists in DJ mixes.
- [Miniverse](https://miniverse.lol): Next generation social media. Invite-only iPhone app for the people in your life.
- [Blonde Brunette](https://blondebrunette.music): Music duo. Nick is one half.
- [Spectrum Patronum](https://spectrumpatronum.es/): Music collective in Barcelona.
- [ReMade BCN](https://www.made-bcn.org/): Community-run makerspace in Barcelona. Nick is a founder and board member.
